study type: Quality improvement initiative with retrospective review
exposure: Use of smartphone app offering patient education, depression screening, social determinants of health screening, and care coordination
cohort: 483 people who initiated prenatal care before 28 weeks of gestation and delivered at the study institution between December 2020 and December 2021
finding: There were no significant differences in mode of delivery or maternal and neonatal outcomes between the group of patients who used the smartphone app and those who did not.
mod_finding: There were no significant differences in mode of delivery between the group of patients who used the smartphone app and those who did not.
